name: Marketplace, Ride-Hailing & SuperApp Ops
description: Screens merchant catalog listings for prohibited terms, prompt-injection payloads, and price outliers, attributes on-demand delivery SLA breaches across merchant prep vs courier transit with force-majeure waivers, and reconciles merchant GMV, commission fees, FX, and PSP settlements.

skills.summary: Detects indirect prompt injection in merchant copy, screens counterfeit/prohibited goods, flags price outliers, and checks attributes.
Splits order delays into merchant prep vs courier transit faults, waives verified weather delays, and assigns refund liability.
Reconciles gross GMV, commission take-rates, promo splits, FX conversions, and PSP wires while flagging negative clawbacks.
